settings.title: Wellness Promise
settings.text: THE mission at Green Envee is to share your passion for holistic wellness that brings positive change to an otherwise toxic beauty industry. The wellness of the skin is a blueprint to understanding overall health. Understanding the connection between skin health and mind + body is an important aspect to the Green Envee spa experience. the commitment to clean beauty + wellness is treated as whole beauty.
